item.title: 🔵 URGENT - Progress Tells ShareFile Customers to Shut Down Storage Zone Controllers Over Security Threat
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Progress Software has told ShareFile customers to shut down the Windows servers running their Storage Zone Controllers, confirming to The Hacker News that it is responding to a "credible external security threat." item.title: 🟠 Laser Attack Resets Tangem Wallet Passwords on Cards That Can't Be Patched
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Researchers at Ledger's Donjon security team have shown that a precisely timed laser pulse, aimed at the chip inside a Tangem crypto wallet card, can reset the card's password to anything the attacker picks.
